bankReco.title: Bank reconciliation
bankReco.subtitle: Bring in the bank statement, match each line to a voucher in the books, and set up the cash and bank accounts.
bankReco.noCompany: No company to show. Admin adds companies on Companies.
bankReco.noBankBody: Admin adds the company's bank accounts on Set-up (only the last 4 digits of the account number are kept).

kpi.matchedSub: Tied to a voucher in the books
kpi.unmatchedSub: Need a voucher or an answer

upload.title: Upload statement (CSV or Excel)
upload.body: Download the statement from the bank as CSV or Excel (.xlsx). If the bank protects the file with a password, you type the password each time; it is never stored. Password-protected Excel files can't be opened in the browser, so export an unprotected CSV from the bank and upload that. Lines already imported are skipped.
upload.mapHelp: Check which column holds each field. Money in and out can be one signed Amount column, or separate Debit and Credit columns (amount = credit − debit).
upload.ready: {{n}} lines ready to import · {{skipped}} rows without a date or amount left out
upload.needDate: Choose the Date column and either Amount or Debit/Credit.

read.protected: This file is password-protected (or an old .xls). The password would be typed here and never stored, but protected Excel files can't be opened in the browser. Export the statement from the bank as an unprotected CSV and upload that.
read.pdf: PDF statements can't be read here yet. Download the statement as CSV or Excel (.xlsx) from the bank.
read.unreadable: This file couldn't be read. Upload the bank's CSV or Excel (.xlsx) statement.
read.noHeader: No header row was found. The file needs a row with column names such as Date, Narration, Debit, Credit, Balance.

bankReco.emptyBodyNoRight: Lines appear here when accounts uploads the statement.
bankReco.matchBody: Statement line of {{d}} for ₹{{amount}} · {{what}}. Vouchers below move the same amount through this bank account within 7 days.
bankReco.noCandBody: Post the receipt or payment first (same amount, same bank account, within 7 days), or ignore the line if it isn't business money.

setup.moneyEmpty: No cash or bank account yet
setup.moneyEmptyBody: Add the cash box and each bank account. They drive the cash book and the reconciliation.
setup.askAdmin: Only Admin (Settings right) changes the set-up. Ask Admin.
setup.bankNote: Only the last 4 digits of the account number are kept; the full number is not needed here.
setup.name: Account name
setup.noGroups: No account groups yet. Add them on Tally books → Chart of accounts.
setup.last4: Last 4 digits of the account number
setup.rulesBody: Each event posts to the account chosen here. Until a rule is set, any posting that needs it stops with "set the posting rule …" — set them all before the first invoice, bill or payroll.
setup.noAccountsBody: Add the accounts on Tally books → Chart of accounts, then choose them here.
